verdict.rationale: A downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question for a product like ChatGPT, so the axis applies. However, the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger file at any candidate path (all returned 404), and nothing in the docs offers a downloadable spec. The llms.txt file, the Codex SDK mention and GPT custom actions that call third-party APIs are adjacent features, not a published spec of the product's own API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
